[[File:Insecticide.png|thumb|right|200px|A cloud of insecticide]]
An '''insecticide''' was a [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] developed specifically to kill [[Insect/Legends|insects]] or [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The people of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] often used [[insecticide mine]]s as defenses against the insectoid [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of their world.

Insecticides could be deploy via pellet; [[CD-2 Harvester]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was equipped with a removable nose attachment that allowed it to dispense insecticide pellets.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
